---
title: "CTCF ChIP-seq and per-guide effects at the FAM111A and CDC37 CTCF elements"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(see)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
  library(data.table)
})
source(here("scripts", "R", "utils.R"))

output_dir <- here("results", "2026-06-30_CTCF_Plots")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# CTCF ChIP-seq signal

```{r}
df <- read.delim(here("analyses", "2026-06-29_CTCF_ChIP_validation", "source_data", "ctcf_signal_per_replicate.tsv"), sep = "\t")
df
```

## FAM111A
```{r}
mask_fam111a <- df$locus_label == "FAM111A_peak" & df$intended_target != "CDC37"
locus_label <- paste0("FAM111A | ", unique(df[mask_fam111a, ]$locus))

plot_df <- df[mask_fam111a, ]

# Targeting guides first, then the controls (empty grna_id)
named_guides <- unique(plot_df$grna_id[plot_df$grna_id != ""])
custom_x_order <- c(sort(named_guides), "")
plot_df$grna_id <- factor(plot_df$grna_id, levels = custom_x_order)

plot_df$intended_target <- factor(plot_df$intended_target, levels = c("FAM111A", "control"))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = grna_id, y = mean_signal, fill = intended_target)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    aspect.ratio = 3/2
  )+
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(title = locus_label, x = "gRNA ID", y = "CTCF signal (CPM)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Crop_3864", "Crop_3866", "Control")) +
  scale_fill_okabeito(order = c(3, 8))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "fam111a_boxplots.pdf"), width = 3, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

## CDC37
```{r}
mask_cdc37 <- df$locus_label == "CDC37_peak" & df$intended_target != "FAM111A"
locus_label <- paste0("CDC37 | ", unique(df[mask_cdc37, ]$locus))

plot_df_cdc37 <- df[mask_cdc37, ]

# Give every control row (empty grna_id) the same fill label
plot_df_cdc37$intended_target[plot_df_cdc37$grna_id == ""] <- "Control"

custom_x_order <- c("WTC11_Random_Screen_Crop_7494", "WTC11_Random_Screen_Crop_7498", "")
plot_df_cdc37$grna_id <- factor(plot_df_cdc37$grna_id, levels = custom_x_order)

plot_df_cdc37$intended_target <- factor(plot_df_cdc37$intended_target, levels = c("CDC37", "Control"))

ggplot(plot_df_cdc37, aes(x = grna_id, y = mean_signal, fill = intended_target)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )+
  ylim(0, 2) +
  labs(title = locus_label, x = "", y = "CTCF signal (CPM)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Crop_7494", "Crop_7498", "Control")) +
  scale_fill_okabeito(order = c(2, 8))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "cdc37_boxplots.pdf"), width = 3, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# Per-guide effects in the original WTC11 screen

Singleton (per-guide) SCEPTRE results of the WTC11 screen, with guide positions lifted from hg19 to hg38.
Element windows and CTCF motifs (hg38) are in `ctcf_element_motifs_hg38.bed`.

```{r}
guides_df <- load_ctcf_element_guide_effects(
  screen_dir = here("..", "results", "process_validation_datasets", "WTC11_DC_TAP_Seq"),
  chain_path = here("data", "hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
)

element_motifs <- fread(
  here("analyses", "2026-06-30_CTCF_Plots", "ctcf_element_motifs_hg38.bed"),
  col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "thick_start", "thick_end", "rgb")
)
bed_feature <- function(feature_name) element_motifs[name == feature_name]
```

## FAM111A

```{r}
fam111a_window <- bed_feature("FAM111A_Region_Window")
fam111a_motif <- bed_feature("FAM111A_CTCF_Motif")
ctcf_motif_start  <- fam111a_motif$start
ctcf_motif_end    <- fam111a_motif$end
ctcf_motif_summit <- (ctcf_motif_start + ctcf_motif_end) / 2 # relative 0

subtitle_text_fam <- paste0("FAM111A region | Plotted window: chr11:", fam111a_window$start, "-", fam111a_window$end)

plot_df_fam <- guides_df[grna_target == "chr11:58925975-58926276"]

all_guides_fam <- unique(plot_df_fam$grna_id)
color_mask_fam <- setNames(rep("black", length(all_guides_fam)), all_guides_fam)
targets_fam <- c("WTC11_Random_Screen_Crop_3864", "WTC11_Random_Screen_Crop_3866")
color_mask_fam[targets_fam] <- "#009E73" # Okabe-Ito bluish green

ggplot(plot_df_fam, aes(x = guide_start_hg38 - ctcf_motif_summit, y = pct_change_effect_size)) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = ctcf_motif_start - ctcf_motif_summit,
           xmax = ctcf_motif_end - ctcf_motif_summit,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray70") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_CI_95_pct_change, ymax = upper_CI_95_pct_change, color = grna_id), width = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(color = grna_id), size = 2.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_mask_fam,
    breaks = targets_fam,
    name = "Target Guides"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-200, 200),
    breaks = c(-200, -100, 0, 100, 200)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Per guide effect relative to primary CTCF motif (hg38)",
    subtitle = subtitle_text_fam,
    x = "Distance from motif summit (bp)",
    y = "Effect Size (% with 95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "fam111a_per_guide_effect_relative_hg38.pdf"), width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

## CDC37

```{r}
cdc37_window <- bed_feature("CDC37_Region_Window")
cdc37_motif1 <- bed_feature("CDC37_CTCF_Motif_1")
cdc37_motif2 <- bed_feature("CDC37_CTCF_Motif_2")
ctcf_motif1_start  <- cdc37_motif1$start
ctcf_motif1_end    <- cdc37_motif1$end
ctcf_motif1_center <- (ctcf_motif1_start + ctcf_motif1_end) / 2 # relative 0
ctcf_motif2_start  <- cdc37_motif2$start
ctcf_motif2_end    <- cdc37_motif2$end
ctcf_motif2_center <- (ctcf_motif2_start + ctcf_motif2_end) / 2

subtitle_text <- paste0("CDC37 region | Plotted window: chr19:", cdc37_window$start, "-", cdc37_window$end)

plot_df_cdc37 <- guides_df[grna_target == "chr19:10501390-10501691"]

all_guides_cdc37 <- unique(plot_df_cdc37$grna_id)
color_mask_cdc37 <- setNames(rep("black", length(all_guides_cdc37)), all_guides_cdc37)
targets_cdc37 <- c("WTC11_Random_Screen_Crop_7494", "WTC11_Random_Screen_Crop_7498")
color_mask_cdc37[targets_cdc37] <- okabeito_colors(2)

ggplot(plot_df_cdc37, aes(x = guide_start_hg38 - ctcf_motif1_center, y = pct_change_effect_size)) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = ctcf_motif1_start - ctcf_motif1_center,
           xmax = ctcf_motif1_end - ctcf_motif1_center,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = ctcf_motif2_start - ctcf_motif1_center,
           xmax = ctcf_motif2_end - ctcf_motif1_center,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ctcf_motif2_center - ctcf_motif1_center, linetype = "dashed", color = "#E69F00", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray70") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_CI_95_pct_change, ymax = upper_CI_95_pct_change, color = grna_id), width = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(color = grna_id), size = 2.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_mask_cdc37,
    breaks = targets_cdc37,
    name = "Target Guides"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-200, 200),
    breaks = c(-200, -100, 0, 100, 200)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Per guide effect relative to primary CTCF motif (hg38)",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x = "Distance from primary motif center (bp)",
    y = "Effect Size (% with 95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "cdc37_per_guide_effect_relative_hg38.pdf"), width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
